chunks: From him, from Amr ibn Uthman, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Zayd al-Shahham, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about fish found floating on the water, which the sea casts up dead: 'Do I eat it?' He said: 'No.'
ai.seo_question: Is floating dead fish halal to eat according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the prohibition of *al-thaffah* (fish that die in water and float), distinguishing it from fish that die after being caught, a key distinction in Shia fiqh regarding aquatic creatures. This ruling underscores the principle that for fish to be halal, they must die out of the water after being caught, reflecting the broader Shia emphasis on specific conditions of slaughter or death for marine life.
